surgeryIndex.description: Aesthetic, intimate and gender-affirming procedures planned around your anatomy, your moment and your goals.
surgeryIndex.procedureText: Every surgery begins with a conversation. The medical assessment considers your history, anatomy, expectations and safety to build a truly individual recommendation.

surgeryIndex.safetyText: The decision is built in consultation, with clear information about possibilities, limits, preparation and recovery.
